prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, wide and side-on inside a deep 1930s brick bank vault under the city, a row of caged bulbs along the ceiling, an open iron furnace door in the back wall glowing orange, and a mountain of bundles of blank green paper money with no printing, each tied with a rubber band, piled almost to the ceiling: the money mountain fills most of the vault, its slope rising left to right, a long wooden plank laid up it, gangsters in pinstripe trousers, waistcoats and rolled shirt-sleeves, sweating: a fat one with a scar through his top lip, a thin bald one with big ears, a young one with slicked red hair and freckles pushing heaped wheelbarrows up the plank in a line, small against the pile. High in the wall, a narrow barred window at pavement level onto the snowy street, cold blue, the boots and shabby trouser hems of a queue of people shuffling past outside. The cold blue of that window is the only cool light in the room. Most of the frame in deep shadow; the brightest values are the caged bulbs, the orange furnace door and the barred window. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
